messages:
Anna (CS): Hey @Miguel + team — quick initial handshake for Kairos integration. TL;DR: stakeholders, success criteria, and a 3-week minimum timeline below. Can owners confirm?

Miguel (CS): Thanks Anna — available Wed 10–11 PT for a quick sync.

Sam (PM): Goals look right. Add success criteria: 95th < 300ms, 99% availability, first 1k meaningful requests in 30 days, onboarding docs + eval checklist complete.

Jess (Eng): I can own model integration & validation. Will create infra tasks. Note: need VPC peering + KMS.

Devon (SE): I'll own runbook + demo. Need test dataset + access plan.

Anna (CS): Proposed owners: Miguel (CS) — overall CS lead; Sam (PM) — product milestones; Jess (Eng) — engineering lead; Devon (SE) — ops/runbook.
Success criteria (short):
• Perf: 95th < 300ms for gen flows
• Reliability: 99% uptime on trial traffic
• Feature parity: streaming + function-calls work end-to-end
• Business: customer has 3 success stories (internal) and exec demo accepted within 30 days

Timeline (high-level):
week 0 — access + sample dataset + account provisioning
week 1 — integration + small smoke tests
week 2 — UAT + performance tuning
week 3 — demo + go/no-go for expansion

Miguel (CS): Quick renewal risk flag: customer has a 60-day budget review. If we don't show traction by day 30 the renewal probability drops. Recommend exec touchpoints at week 2 and week 4.

Sam (PM): Agreed. I'll draft a 30/60/90 milestones doc and ask Sales to pause any hard renewal triggers until we hit the demo milestone.

Jess (Eng): Infra question — are we doing a Hosted trial or Dedicated reserved pool for this customer? Need to know sizing.

Anna (CS): They asked for a Dedicated trial. I'll attach the contract notes. Also we need IP allowlist + KMS permissions from their side. Miguel can you collect that?

Devon (SE): For enablement: propose a 1-hour live walkthrough on UAT day and a runbook (ops + rollback). I'll draft the runbook.

Jess (Eng): Perf test snippet I'll use for smoke:
```
# run perf harness (local)
python perf_runner.py --target https://kairos.trial.redwood --concurrency 8 --requests 200
```
Will start with the above and iterate.

OnboardBot: Reminder set — initial sync scheduled 2026-05-06 17:00 UTC (calendar invite posted).

Sam (PM): Also: capture customer feedback after each UAT session. I'll post the "onboard-feedback" google form link here once the milestone doc is ready.

Anna (CS): Next steps recap: Miguel — collect KMS/IP + confirm sample dataset by Fri; Jess — infra provisioning + perf scripts starting Mon; Devon — runbook + schedule walkthrough; Sam — milestones doc + feedback form. I'll post a Confluence recap after this thread. :thumbsup:

Miguel (CS): On it — will ping if I hit any blockers.

Jess (Eng): Added tasks in tracker: infra/provision, perf tests, UAT checklist. ETA Mon EOD for initial PR.

Devon (SE): Runbook draft ETA Tue EOD.

Sam (PM): Will share milestone doc in this thread when ready.

Anna (CS): Thanks everyone — closing thread for now. I'll follow up in calendar + Confluence.
